reader.requirement: At --std 85, an OPEN (INPUT, I-O or EXTEND) of an existing indexed file whose implementor-validated fixed file attributes conflict with the program's file control entry and FD must be unsuccessful, setting I-O status 39 (IX.1.3.4 item 4e) and leaving the file not open; the validated set is implementor-defined and may vary by organization (DOC-A.1-129: organization, record type, min/max record size, and the key table for indexed).
reader.edition-search: grep -n 'Edition|CobolVersion|DialectBehavior' in FileConnector.cs, KeyedConnector.cs, FixedFileAttributes.cs, IndexedConnector.cs: the only edition reads on the OPEN path are SharingFacilityInEffect (file-sharing facility, not this rule); the GR8 check at OpenOnceEntered line 1245 and Conflicts read no edition, so 85 takes the same code as 2023.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the 85 witness open_fixed_attribute_conflict exercises a RELATIVE subject and sequential subjects only; the indexed key-table half (open_fixed_attribute_conflict_ix) is accept 2023 only, so the indexed organization this rule belongs to is not witnessed at 85 (covered here by probe).
